company.name: Northwood Space
company.shortDescription: Northwood Space designs ground infrastructure for spacecraft communication and data handling with deployable systems for connectivity.
company.description: Northwood Space designs and delivers ground infrastructure for spacecraft communication and data handling, focusing on scalable and rapidly deployable systems for satellite connectivity. The company produces phased-array antenna hardware and integrated software that enable simultaneous communication with multiple satellites across various orbits, aiming to simplify ground station deployment and operations for space operators. Its solutions include modular gateways and networking stacks that support dynamic capacity provisioning and resilience for demanding satellite missions. Northwood’s technology replaces traditional ground station models with manufacturing-oriented systems intended to accelerate time from production to live data delivery. Customers use its products to establish links for satellite telemetry, tracking, command, and data backhaul without extensive custom integration challenges.
